messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Customer X requested Eon-Lite-3B (quant-ready) to be onboarded this week. They care about latency and cost. Can we intake and prioritize?
Ryan: +1 for priority. It's close to production use case we benchmarked earlier. What are known gaps?
Elena: Quick note: model doc shows tokenizer variant with soft-emojis which previously caused tokenization drift. Also no 4-bit PTQ profile yet.
Sam: Suggest prioritization rubric: customer impact, perf delta vs baseline, estimated engineer-days, regression risk. For this request: high customer impact, medium perf delta, ~3-4 engineer-days. => high priority.
Maya: OK. I'll open intake ticket. For bring-up checklist — can we run the usual smoke + quant experiments? Draft checklist below:
Maya: ```Bring-up checklist:
- Repro baseline generation (fp16) on our test harness
- Tokenizer parity tests (1000 random corpora)
- PTQ/QLoRA 4-bit smoke (one pass) + perf profile
- KV cache correctness tests (long context 8k)
- Latency microbench (p50/p95/p99) with assumed batch sizes
- Functional evals: code generation, chat, tool-calling smoke
- Safety/eval hooks and prompt set run
- Canary rollout config (5% traffic, 1 region)
- Monitoring alerts: embed drift, generation perplexity, repetition score
```
Ryan: Add: compare tokenization on emojis and CJK, and run reranker back-compat tests.
Elena: Also flag quant failure modes: hallucination spikes in q4 with fused-attn. Add an eval for factual QA (20 examples).
Maya: I'm attaching initial plan in the ticket. bench-bot: perf-harness queued: run 3 configs (fp16, q4f, q4s) on gtx-pool-2.
bench-bot: job 55823 started — estimated 45m.
Ryan: While that's running, quick ask: can infra-bot provision a canary slot in us-west-2? Need isolated route for 5% traffic and rollback.
infra-bot: Canary host group created: eon-lite-canary-usw2. Route config ready.
Sam: After initial runs, if q4 shows >5% BLEU drop on code tasks or >10% increase in repetition score, we hold and iterate.
bench-bot: job 55823 done. Results summary: fp16 baseline p50=38ms, p95=120ms, p99=210ms. q4s p50=30ms, p95=135ms, p99=260ms. q4f p50=32ms, p95=128ms, p99=240ms.
Maya: q4s improved p50 but p99 regressed. Elena, any insights?
Elena: p99 regression likely due to KV-cache flushes under long contexts; also found tokenization mismatch on emoji sequences causing longer decode loops in a few samples.
Ryan: Repro steps?
Elena: Repro snippet: 
```python
prompt = "Here's some emoji: 😂😂😂 and some CJK: こんにちは 你好"
outputs = model.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=256, use_cache=True)
# q4s output showed repeated segments after token boundary mismatch
```
Elena: I've pushed a small tokenizer patch to the canary image to normalize emoji ZWJ sequences.
Maya: Any quality regressions in evals? bench-bot: show eval results.
bench-bot: eval-summary: code-gen pass@1 dropped 6% on 100-sample suite for q4s. QA factual accuracy: fp16 88%, q4s 81%. Repetition metric: baseline 0.03 -> q4s 0.12.
Sam: That's non-trivial. We should rollback canary and mark this for quantization follow-up.
Maya: Rolling back canary now. infra-bot: rollback executed.
infra-bot: Rollback complete, canary traffic drained.
Ryan: Next steps: Elena to iterate on tokenizer + KV-cache handling, Sam to run alternative quant profile (q4f with per-channel clip), bench team to run focused eval set (50 critical customer prompts). Time estimate: 2-3 days.
Elena: Starting tokenizer/kv fixes. I'll post smaller PRs and link failing examples.
Maya: I'll surface customer update: delaying rollout pending fixes; will offer short-term fp16 dedicated slot if they need.
Sam: Also add monitoring rule: if repetition score > 0.08 on canary, auto-scale down to fallback model.
Maya: Good. Thanks team. Closing loop when fixes land and we get improved eval numbers. :thumbsup:
